subdomains.name: Inevitable Subdomain (Law)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Touch of Law with Command and replace the Law domain's 3rd-, 5th-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Command
powers.summary: As a standard action, issue an order as command; a Will save negates, and a creature cannot be targeted more than once per day. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Staff of Order
powers.summary: As a standard action, give a touched weapon the axiomatic special ability for rounds equal to half cleric level. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

subdomains.name: Freedom Subdomain (Liberation)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Liberation with Liberty's Blessing and replace the Liberation domain's 1st- and 5th-level spells.

powers.name: Liberty's Blessing
powers.summary: As a standard action, grant a willing creature a 1-minute boon it may expend as a swift action to retry a save against an ongoing effect and end that effect on success. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Freedom's Call
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Allies within it suppress the confused, grappled, frightened, panicked, paralyzed, pinned, and shaken conditions.

subdomains.name: Revolution Subdomain (Liberation)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Freedom's Call with Powerful Persuader and replace the Liberation domain's 2nd- and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Liberation
powers.summary: Automatically ignore magical effects that impede movement as freedom of movement for a total number of rounds per day equal to cleric level.

powers.name: Powerful Persuader
powers.summary: As a free action, roll a Diplomacy or Intimidate check twice and take the higher result. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per two levels beyond 8th.

subdomains.name: Curse Subdomain (Luck)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Bit of Luck with Malign Eye and replace the Luck domain's 1st-, 3rd-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Malign Eye
powers.summary: As a standard action, give a target within 30 feet a -2 penalty on saves against your spells for 1 minute or until it hits you. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Good Fortune
powers.summary: As an immediate action before the result is revealed, reroll one d20 roll you just made. Usable once per day at 6th level, plus once per six levels beyond 6th.

subdomains.name: Fate Subdomain (Luck)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Good Fortune with Tugging Strands and replace the Luck domain's 2nd- and 3rd-level spells.

powers.name: Bit of Luck
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a willing creature. During its next round it rolls each d20 twice and takes the better result. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Tugging Strands
powers.summary: Before its result is revealed, force a creature in line of sight to reroll a roll and use the new result. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per six levels beyond 8th.
